inputs.name: Finite local Tate duality with the normalized Brauer invariant
inputs.statement: For every finite extension K/Q_p and every finite continuous ell-primary G_K-module M, finite local cohomology vanishes above degree two; cup products with Hom(M,mu_{ell^r}) are perfect in degrees (0,2),(1,1),(2,0), with H2(mu_{ell^r}) identified by the Brauer invariant. No freeness or p!=ell hypothesis.

inputs.name: Global finiteness for finite S-cohomology
inputs.statement: If S is finite, contains all archimedean places and all places dividing |M|, and M is a finite continuous G_{F,S}-module, every finite-degree cohomology group is finite. In degrees at least three its real-place comparison gives zero for odd ell.

inputs.name: Noetherian completion and Krull intersection
inputs.statement: Completion is exact on finite modules over a Noetherian ring, remains Noetherian, and agrees modulo every power of the completed ideal. For a Noetherian local ring and a proper ideal, the intersection of its powers in a finite module is zero.
